title: What's New: Legislation and Localization (2023 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Localization strategy and W1 base app enrichment
Delocalization process and Swedish deprecation timeline
EU three-party trade and automatic account codes apps
Registration number field, Audit File Expert, and GL Account Mapping
Intrastat Improvements: Drop Shipment and Czech Localization
Report Formatting Summary and Closing Remarks

features.name: EU three-party trade app
features.description: App for purchase transactions that helps customers report transactions where goods are sent to a different EU country without entering the country of residence, enabling VAT compliance reporting.
caveats: Requires manual definition of transaction type in purchase invoice

features.name: Automatic account codes
features.description: Functionality using customized posting groups to automate recurring transactions in journals and sales or purchase documents, allowing allocation across different accounts or dimensions.
caveats: Must be configured in automatic account groups page before use

features.name: Registration number field
features.description: Additional registration field added across company information, customer, vendor and contact cards for countries where authorities require additional registration beyond VAT registration.

features.name: Audit File Expert
features.description: Functionality that provides an interface for extensions to export accounting and tax data in various formats like Norwegian SFT, Swedish SIE, and French FEC. Allows scheduling to off-work hours and parallel processing with options to split data by months or dates.
caveats: Must be extended by country-specific implementations
specific form expansions needed for different countries

features.name: GL Account Mapping
features.description: Provides ability to map chart of accounts to standard accounts when exporting data through Audit File Expert extension, addressing regulatory authority requirements.

features.name: Swedish delocalization
features.description: Process of removing Swedish local functionalities from base app starting with version 22 and 23, marking code as obsolete pending, with complete removal planned by version 29 and table removal by version 30.
caveats: Follows specific deprecation timeline over multiple releases
Table deletion follows different pattern than code deletion

features.name: 23 new countries in cloud
features.description: Cloud solution expanded with 23 new countries in this release, bringing total to 155 markets available from December 2023.
features.status_evidence_quote: these new countries will be available from December this year

features.name: Drop Shipment for Triangular Intrastat Trade
features.description: Enables use of drop shipment in intrastat reporting for triangular trade scenarios where goods bypass the reporting company's country. Must enable include drop shipment toggle in intrastat report setup page.
caveats: must enable toggle in intrastat report setup
requires item ledger entries marked as drop shipment
based on country region code differences

features.name: Intrastat Czech Localization
features.description: Intrastat is now localized for Czech Republic with new release wave 2, extending intrastat module usage globally.

features.name: Report Formatting Enhancements
features.description: Support for defining report format and region directly from the application request page, AL code, and customer/vendor cards. Previously format could only be changed through settings page. Includes format region property on report objects and cascade fallback to settings.
caveats: fallback to settings if not configured

features.name: Report Format Region Property
features.description: AL code support for defining format region directly on report object through new format region property, enabling flexible report output formatting.

features.name: Customer/Vendor Report Format Definition
features.description: Ability to define language and format region for specific customers or vendors directly from vendor or customer card, using the same pattern as language settings.
